entities.name: SERPINE1
observations: PAI-1/SERPINE1 mRNA was detected by 35S-labeled riboprobe in adult rodent ciliary-process epithelial cells, predominantly at process apices; the abstract reports this as the exclusive adult ocular site.
During development, signal was also transiently detected in the retinal ganglion-cell layer at postnatal days 1–4.

entities.name: PMID:10752934
observations: Primary study titled 'Plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 mRNA is localized in the ciliary epithelium of the rodent eye.' Used in situ hybridization on cryostat eye sections; aqueous-humor PAI-1 activity was assessed separately by reverse zymography.
The accessible abstract identifies the model as rodent but does not establish rat versus mouse.

entities.name: Adult ciliary PAI-1 mRNA
observations: In adult rodent eyes, PAI-1 mRNA is reported exclusively in epithelial cells of the ciliary processes, especially at their apices, based on in situ hybridization.
This conclusion concerns mRNA localization; aqueous-humor PAI-1 activity was measured separately.
